items.title: JetBlue Raises Bag Fees for the Second Time This Year
items.snippet: Skift Take: JetBlue’s second bag fee increase this year tests how much more travelers will absorb. For travelers in economy, the cost of checking a bag is now $50, up from $45, if purchased more than 24 hours before departure, according to its website. Bags checked in within 24 hours of departure will cost $60.

items.title: Fewer Calls, Better Service: Canary AI at The Pines Resort
items.snippet: The Pines Resort cut guest messaging response times from 45 to 2 minutes and automated high-volume phone inquiries after deploying Canary AI Voice, Webchat, and Guest Messaging.

items.title: Starhotels strengthens its leadership with Francesco Brunetti and Marco Gilardi
items.snippet: Italian hotel group Starhotels is evolving its organisation to support its growth. Francesco Brunetti becomes Deputy CEO & Asset Director, while Marco Gilardi, formerly of Minor Hotels, joins the group as Managing Director Hospitality.

items.title: The Postcard Hotel to Open in Nepal with ThePostcard on the Rapti River, Chitwan
items.snippet: The Postcard Hotel is set to make its debut in Nepal with the opening of The Postcard on the Rapti River, Chitwan , in November 2026. Set along a picturesque bend of the Rapti River, with uninterrupted views of the surrounding forests and hills, the 22-room-and-suite luxury retreat adjoins the buffer zone of Chitwan National Park, one of South Asia’s most significant wildlife destinations.

items.title: Placemakr opens second apart-hotel property in Arizona
items.snippet: The new-build Placemakr Tempe, Apartments by Hilton comes as “demand for apartment-style stays is outpacing supply” in the greater Phoenix market, per CEO Jason Fundin. Correction: This article has been updated with the correct spelling of Placemakr’s CEO. It is Jason Fudin. Hilton launched the Apartment Collection category in January with Placemakr to institutionalize home-style stays.

items.title: Accor expands Rajasthan portfolio with signing of Novotel Bhilwara Resort and Spa
items.snippet: Accor has signed Novotel Bhilwara Resort and Spa in Rajasthan, expanding its hospitality portfolio in the state. Scheduled to open in 2026, the 144-room property will introduce the Novotel brand to Bhilwara, known as the Textile City of India, with a fully vegetarian dining concept and extensive facilities for weddings, social celebrations and business events.

items.title: HRAWI Trains 44 Hospitality Professionals Under FoSTaC in Mumbai
items.snippet: The Hotel and Restaurant Association of Western India (HRAWI) conducted the Food Safety Supervisor Training in Advance Catering (FoSTaC), an initiative of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), at Pritam Da Dhaba in Dadar, Mumbai, on October 30. The programme saw the participation of 44 hospitality professionals.

items.title: Over 40 international buyers to take part in ITM for NE India at Tawang
items.snippet: TBM Staff | New Delhi According to the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, over 200 travel and tourism stakeholders will participate in the 14th annual edition of International Travel Mart (ITM) for the North Eastern Region, which will include over 40 international buyers drawn from 22 countries of the world. The three-day annual event will get underway in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, today.

items.title: AltAir House arrives in Kolkata and Siliguri as Ambuja Neotia and IHCL deepen their eastern expansion
items.snippet: Ambuja Neotia Group and Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) have launched AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions in Kolkata and Siliguri, marking a significant step in their expanding hospitality partnership. The openings accompany an investment commitment of around Rs 2,700 crore across West Bengal, including projects in Kolkata, Raichak, Digha, Siliguri, Lataguri, Kalimpong and Darjeeling.

items.title: Marriott lifts annual room revenue growth forecast on resilient travel demand
items.snippet: With robust travel demand and a rise in bookings, Marriott International anticipates significant room revenue growth. Their recent report shows an uptick in revenue per available room across the upscale sector, notably including Ritz-Carlton. The third quarter brought in nearly $7 billion, outperforming Wall Street estimates.
